header.label: Simulation
header.title: Test your boundaries.
header.p1: Simulations are interactive stories where you get to try challenging work life situations without real risk.
header.p2: You can practice intervening, drawing your own boundaries, or just observe how different interaction situations feel.

dialog.title: Simulation Principles
dialog.p1_text: No choice leads to real danger. You can always interrupt.
dialog.p2_text: You decide how you proceed. There is no one right way.
dialog.p3_text: Performance is not important, but what you learn about yourself.
